User reported creating a GitHub repository named Monarch-Studio. Exact visible message was captured; a newly created empty public candidate at adil-chandio/Monarch-Studio was discovered but is not assumed to belong to the user until explicitly confirmed.
User explicitly confirmed https://github.com/adil-chandio/Monarch-Studio as the target repository. Standard Git transport will be attempted once; GitHub connector is unsupported.

User explicitly confirmed the exact empty GitHub repository https://github.com/adil-chandio/Monarch-Studio. Origin was configured and read-verified empty; checkpoint captures the confirmation and prepares the first canonical push.
First confirmed GitHub push attempt could not authenticate because no non-interactive Git credential was configured. No repository data was accepted remotely.
Used GitHub CLI device authorization with the user in the browser; credentials stayed in an ephemeral /tmp config and no token/password was written to chat or repository.
First authenticated push was rejected because the OAuth token had repo scope but not workflow scope required for .github/workflows/continuity-audit.yml.
Refreshed authorization through a second GitHub device flow with workflow scope; user approved without sharing credentials.

GitHub push succeeded and was verified: origin https://github.com/adil-chandio/Monarch-Studio.git; refs/heads/main=6278891733b48b63277e5f545781b6e0465e1c82; continuity-v1 annotated tag object=2a4dc67c316ecbad8c72422a3c09eaca834871e8, peeled commit=c5226d972c4c27982edf17777aba5aead62f4820.
GitHub Continuity audit run 38090599906 failed repository validation because .studio-manifest.json included the ignored runtime lock .continuity.lock, which is absent in a clean checkout.
Fixed tools/studio.py eligible_repo_files to exclude .continuity.lock explicitly; this keeps runtime synchronization locks outside the permanent integrity manifest.
GitHub run 38090663018 passed repository validation and continuity audit but failed the WF-03 hydration smoke test because the clean runner had no NumPy renderer dependencies installed.
Updated CI to install the pinned requirements/render.txt dependency set with pip caching; also upgraded deprecated Node-based actions to the current verified checkout@v7 and setup-python@v7 releases.
